title: Mad World
hook: The *one bright note* that makes Mad World ache
cover_text: One *bright note* in a dark room

chords.name: G
chords.text: Up to *G major*. Brighter, but the same notes.

chords.name: A
chords.text: *A major*, not minor. Its C♯ doesn't belong here.

chords.name: Em
chords.text: Back to E minor. *Hope that doesn't fit* is what haunts.
